test_title: PYST 35: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 12 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: **Select the sentence with the appropriate use of preposition.**

options.text: Are you interested along with modern art?
Are you interested into modern art?
Are you interested with modern art?
Are you interested in modern art?

solution:
The correct answer is **'Are you interested in modern art?'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Among the given options only option four is correct. In this sentence, all the prepositions are correctly used.
 
• The reason why this sentence is correct is that the preposition "in" is commonly used to show interest or involvement in a particular field or subject. In this case, "in" is used to express an interest in the subject of modern art. &
